single_question: After outcome-blind realized-dose mapping, does the hard-minus-mass operator difference arise before matching/native readout, at the readout chain, in both, or neither?

mapping.scale: model-specific pooled standard deviation across hard and all mass doses

estimands.readout_gate_reason: rematched and native totals inherit upstream fixed effects; only matching and selection increments localize readout-specific differences

statistics.difference: simultaneous interval lies wholly above +margin or below -margin

terminal_rule.T1_PRE_READOUT_DIFFERENCE: at least one pre-readout difference, no readout-chain difference
terminal_rule.T1_READOUT_DEPENDENT: no pre-readout difference, at least one readout-chain difference
terminal_rule.T1_PARTIAL_MIXED: both pre-readout and readout-chain differences, including cross-model component divergence
terminal_rule.T1_TRANSPORT_EQUIVALENT: all endpoints in both models are equivalent
terminal_rule.T1_INCONCLUSIVE: no detected difference and not all endpoints are equivalent
